ShadowRealm hosts create isolated globals and module records, wrap callable values freshly in both directions, copy execution errors and preserve syntax-error phases. Module requests retain source, defer and evaluation phases. Deferred namespaces evaluate on string operations except then; asynchronous transitive dependencies evaluate eagerly. The loader provides AbstractModuleSource and its Test262 host representation; JavaScript source requests reject with SyntaxError. JSON, text and immutable bytes modules use type-specific identities and native synthetic default exports. Attributes, top-level await and direct eval are enabled.
